---
name: Ask about a file workflow
about: Check which example, tool or service fits a non-sensitive file task.
title: "[Workflow question] "
---

This question will be public. Please do not upload real files or include customer data, personal information, credentials or payment references. Use invented values if an example helps.

The owner's AI assistant may reply. This is a scope discussion, not a paid order or a commitment to perform work. Existing Upwork customers should use their contract conversation instead.

### What result do you need?

For example: compare two exports, map supplier columns to a template, extract a text-PDF table, or clarify a result in this repository.

### What is the input?

File type, approximate rows/columns or PDF pages, and whether the task is one-time or recurring. For PDFs, say whether the text can be selected or the pages are scanned images. Please do not attach the file.

### What is unclear or going wrong?

A short description is enough. An optional invented example can show the input and expected result.

### How would you prefer to work?

Run a tool locally / discuss a file-preparation service / understand the free example / unsure.

For paid file work, scope, permitted AI use, data-sharing rights and any order must be agreed through the relevant [CatalogOps service](https://inu-gumi.pro/exportcheck/site/support#choose-product). Product purchases and delivery questions belong in [private support](https://inu-gumi.pro/exportcheck/site/support).
